decisions.reason: With a dedicated page and a multi-model line, the firm has invested heavily and committed publicly, so it is very likely to persist even if results disappoint.
Although only mentioned on the website, it has been on the market since 2023 and is close to the established offer, so sunk costs and responsibility make a drop unlikely.
As a 2024 launch, any disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary causes, and the firm remains committed to its recent product.
